Maya (AE): Prospect (large healthcare org) asks: can we run a 60-day on-prem POC in an air-gapped DMZ? They need details on packaging, patch cadence, and offline activation.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Yes. We offer a self-contained bundle. Qs: do they accept delta patches or only full image swaps? Any certified media process?
Lina (Security): They require SBOM, signed manifests, and a process where the customer re-signs artifacts with their internal CA. No outbound egress allowed. Also need proof that private keys never leave their HSM.
Theo (SRE): Ops note: typical POC bundle ~2.8GB compressed. Full-image update ~2.8GB, delta patching usually 20-400MB depending on model layers changed. Delta pipeline requires a small reconciler service to apply diffs; we can run that as a one-off container during update.
Maya (AE): Pricing and SOW asks: cost for 60-day POC + airgap packaging + signed SBOM. Any estimates?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: POC license $9k (60 days), airgap packaging & SBOM kit $5k one-time, on-site or remote assist hours billed separately. Custom delta tooling integration + CA automation + replay tests add ~$6k.
Lina (Security): For acceptance they'll want: CycloneDX SBOM, signed attestations, reproducible build hashes, and an offline verification CLI that uses the local CA bundle. We must provide cert rotation docs and HSM key-wrap examples. No ephemeral external token allowed.
Theo (SRE): Proposed offline activation flows:
1) License file flow: customer sends CSR (or internal fingerprint) and we return signed license blob. No outbound required.
2) Time-limited offline token: we generate token and customer imports it via USB. Token validated locally.
Both supported. Lina prefers CSR/license for key custody reasons.
pkg-bot: bundle a1b2c3 redwood-airgap-poc-2026.tar.gz sha256=9f8e... signature=OK :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Install runbook (short):
- Verify sha256 against SBOM
- Import customer CA certs to truststore
- sudo ./redwood-installer --bundle redwood-airgap-poc-2026.tar.gz --no-network
- For delta: sudo ./redwood-updater --apply delta-2026-01.patch; reconciler container must run with write access to /var/cache/redwood
- Rollback: sudo ./redwood-updater --rollback v2026.01
Theo (SRE): Add: run pkg-bot verify before and after transfer, and use signed manifests. If reconciler cannot run due to policy, fallback to full-image replace.
Maya (AE): Customer also asked about upgrade cadence. They only allow monthly maintenance windows. Can we support urgent CVE fixes?
Lina (Security): We can support emergency hotfixes via signed delta but will require a change approval ticket and on-call sign-off. Document that in the security checklist.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Action items:
- I'll produce a 1-page install + patch runbook and sample commands (EOD)
- Theo: short SRE note on reconciler resources and fallback plan (EOD)
- Lina: security checklist + HSM/KMS key handling blurb (tomorrow AM)
Maya (AE): I'll present this in the customer briefing tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:
